summary.en: U.S. equities face headwinds as Middle East tensions lift oil prices and AI-related jitters pressure tech stocks ahead of key earnings. Nasdaq futures fall over 1% while investors weigh Tesla and Meta results. Broader market sentiment is risk-off amid geopolitical uncertainty and inflation concerns.
summary.zh: 美股面临阻力，中东紧张局势推高油价，AI 担忧打压科技股。纳斯达克期货跌超 1%，投资者关注特斯拉和META财报。地缘政治不确定性和通胀担忧导致市场情绪避险。

title.en: Middle East Tensions Drive Oil Rally as Geopolitical Risk Premium Expands
title.zh: 中东紧张局势推升油价，地缘政治风险溢价扩大

impact.en: Rising oil prices signal inflation persistence, which could push Fed to hold rates longer. WTI/Brent climbing impacts energy sector directly and raises cost pressures for industrials and EV makers.
impact.zh: 油价上涨表明通胀粘性，可能迫使美联储维持利率更久。WTI/布伦特上涨直接利好能源板块，同时增加工业和电动车成本压力。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Higher oil → inflation expectations ↑ → Fed pivot delayed → growth stocks pressured
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 油价↑→通胀预期↑→美联储转鹰→成长股承压

title.en: Nasdaq Futures Sink as AI Doubts Resurface Over Valuation Concerns
title.zh: 纳斯达克期货因估值担忧和 AI 质疑下跌

impact.en: Big tech and AI chip makers under pressure. Broader growth rotation expected if sentiment deteriorates further. Supply chain feedback from semiconductor sector will cascade to big tech earnings.
impact.zh: 大科技和AI芯片制造商承压。若情绪进一步恶化，预期成长股轮动。半导体板块供应链反馈将传导至大科技财报。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Tech valuation compression → Nasdaq breadth deterioration → growth rotation risk
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 科技股估值压缩→纳指广度恶化→成长股轮动风险

title.en: Tesla Earnings Preview: Delivery Numbers Could Be Mixed Amid Macro Headwinds
title.zh: 特斯拉财报前瞻：交付数据可能因宏观阻力而平淡

impact.en: TSLA earnings could provide clarity on EV demand and pricing power. Higher rates and oil prices may impact consumer sentiment and discretionary spending, affecting Tesla's core model sales.
impact.zh: 特斯拉财报将揭示电动车需求和定价权。高利率和油价可能影响消费者情绪和可支配收入，影响特斯拉核心车型销售。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Macro headwinds → weak consumer demand → EV sector softness risk
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 宏观阻力→消费需求疲软→电动车板块走弱风险

title.en: French Unrest and European Instability Raise Global Growth Concerns
title.zh: 法国骚乱和欧洲不稳定引发全球增长担忧

impact.en: European instability may impact global supply chains and sentiment. Could lead to flight-to-safety flows into defensive sectors and precious metals.
impact.zh: 欧洲不稳定可能影响全球供应链和情绪。可能导致资金流向防御板块和贵金属的避险交易。

macroRisk.en: Moderate - Geopolitical uncertainty → EM asset weakness → rotation to safe havens
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 地缘政治不确定→新兴市场资产走弱→转向避险资产

title.en: Treasury Yields Stable but Watch for Fed Speakers and Inflation Data Expectations
title.zh: 美债收益率稳定，但关注美联储讲话和通胀数据预期

impact.en: 10Y Treasury yield stability supports rate-sensitive sectors but uncertainty around monetary policy remains key risk. Any hawkish comments could trigger broader sell-off in growth stocks.
impact.zh: 10 年美债收益率稳定支持利率敏感板块，但对货币政策的担忧仍是主要风险。任何鹰派言论可能引发成长股 broadly 抛售。

macroRisk.en: Moderate - Policy uncertainty → growth stock volatility → yield sensitivity risk
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 政策不确定→成长股波动→收益率敏感性风险

ai.en: AI sector under pressure as valuations compress and concerns about profitability sustainability resurface. Chip demand may slow if macro environment deteriorates further.
ai.zh: AI 板块承压，估值压缩和盈利可持续性担忧再现。若宏观环境进一步恶化，芯片需求可能放缓。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductors linked to broader tech weakness. Supply chain feedback from design tools and equipment will cascade to end customers. Watch for earnings guidance cuts.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体与大科技走弱相关。设计工具和设备的供应链反馈将传导至终端客户。关注业绩指引下调风险。

bigTech.en: Big tech stocks face valuation headwinds with AI concerns resurfacing. META and MSFT could be hit hardest as growth stories get re-evaluated against rising rates backdrop.
bigTech.zh: 大科技股票面临估值阻力，AI 担忧再现。META和MSFT在加息背景下重新评估成长故事时可能受冲击最大。

energy.en: Energy sector is a clear winner as oil prices rally on geopolitical tensions. XOM and CVX leading gains with direct exposure to crude price spikes.
energy.zh: 能源板块因油价上涨而成为明确赢家，XOM和CVX直接受益于原油价格飙升，领涨。

ev.en: EV sector faces headwinds from higher rates and oil prices that could impact consumer discretionary spending. TSLA earnings will test demand sustainability.
ev.zh: 电动车板块面临高利率和油价上涨的阻力，可能影响消费者可支配收入。特斯拉财报将测试需求可持续性。

market.en: Broad market sentiment is risk-off with Nasdaq futures down 1%+. Defensive positioning expected as geopolitical uncertainty weighs on growth stocks.
market.zh: 大盘情绪避险，纳斯达克期货跌超1%，地缘政治不确定性打压成长股，预期防御性配置增加。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver benefiting from geopolitical uncertainty and potential flight-to-safety flows. Defensive positioning amid European instability.
preciousMetals.zh: 金银受益于地缘政治不确定性和潜在避险资金流。欧洲不稳定下的防御性配置。

oil.en: Oil prices climbing significantly on Middle East tensions. WTI and Brent testing resistance levels as risk premium expands in global markets.
oil.zh: 油价因中东紧张局势显著上涨，WTI和布伦特测试阻力位，全球市场风险溢价扩大。

futures.en: Nasdaq futures down >1%, S&P 500 futures roughly even to slightly negative, Dow mixed as tech leads losses
futures.zh: 纳指期货跌超1%，标普500期货大致持平至微幅下跌，道指随科技股拖累表现混合

treasury10Y.en: 10Y yield stable around 4.2-4.3% range, watch for Fed speaker commentary
treasury10Y.zh: 10年期收益率稳定在4.2-4.3%区间，关注美联储讲话评论

dxy.en: DXY elevated as safe haven flows and risk-off sentiment support dollar
dxy.zh: 美元指数因避险资金和风险厌恶情绪而高位

oil.en: WTI above $70, Brent higher on geopolitical tensions and supply concerns
oil.zh: WTI超70美元，布伦特因地缘政治紧张和供应担忧上涨

keyRisk.en: Middle East escalation + Tesla earnings tomorrow + Fed policy uncertainty drive today's risk-off tone
keyRisk.zh: 中东局势升级+明日特斯拉财报+美联储政策不确定主导今日避险情绪

note.en: Geopolitical tensions (Middle East, Europe) combined with AI valuation concerns and macro headwinds create a defensive market regime. Key earnings could shift sentiment but current risk-off bias is clear.
note.zh: 地缘政治紧张（中东、欧洲）叠加AI估值担忧和宏观阻力形成防御性市场格局。关键财报可能改变情绪，但当前避险主导明确。
